ad_info.reference_style: Native-looking smartphone notes-app screenshot with a short personal plan for December and an attached casual photo of the bottle next to a swimsuit and sunglasses
ad_info.angle_used: Rápido y fácil: su plan para diciembre, fácil de cumplir

global_identity.color_palette: Native notes-app colors: bone white #F6F1E7 background, near-black #1C1C1E text, mid grey #8A8A8E for the date. Brand accent hot fuchsia #E6177F only on the back chevron, the 'Notas' label, the bar icons and the checks. Secondary colors for this variation: bone white and translucent highlighter yellow #FFE45C (the highlighter stroke). The attached photo may show brand tones in the props.
global_identity.visual_style: Native phone screenshot that reads as organic personal content, not an ad; the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo in the attached picture.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Personal, practical and hopeful: a real woman planning her December.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat UI, single left-aligned column, one hand-drawn highlighter stroke, one rounded-corner photo. No device frame, no stickers, no decorative graphics.
global_identity.text_typography: Native system sans-serif look (Inter) for the whole note: bold title, regular list, small grey date; the seal line in Inter SemiBold.

creative_objective: Speak to the woman with a close date (December, vacations at the coast) and show that the plan is easy to keep, in a format that does not look like an ad; the 2 capsules are the highlighted first step.

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The bold note title. 2) The four-step list with the first step highlighted in yellow. 3) The attached photo of the bottle with the swimsuit and sunglasses. 4) The discreet app chrome and the small seal line.
art_direction.composition_style: Full-bleed flat screenshot of a generic notes app in light mode, no device frame, no perspective. One strict left-aligned column at a 6% margin. The attached photo spans the full content width near the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Status bar y 0-4%. Navigation bar y 4-10%. Note title y 12-17.5%. Date line y 18.5-21.5%. List y 24-52% (4 single-line items, line spacing about 1.5x). Attached photo y 55-89%, x 6-94%, corner radius about 2.5% of the canvas. Seal line y 91.5-95%, left-aligned at 6%. Margins 6%.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat, evenly lit UI with no shadows or gradients. Only the attached photo has real light: soft window daylight, top-down casual phone shot with mild depth of field.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, credible, personal and easy

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square crop of a generic notes app in light mode on bone white. Minimal status bar at the top; navigation bar with a back chevron and 'Notas' in fuchsia on the left and share and three-dot icons on the right. The note: bold title, small grey date line, a four-item checkbox list with the first item under a yellow highlighter stroke, a rounded-corner top-down photo of the bottle on a beach towel next to a swimsuit and sunglasses, and under it one small grey seal line.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Flat bone white #F6F1E7 with an ultra-subtle paper grain; never pure white, never brand-colored.
Time on the left, generic signal, wifi and battery glyphs on the right, small and dark grey. No carrier, no notch, no platform icons.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 flat screenshot of a generic smartphone notes app in light mode, no device frame, no perspective: the canvas is the phone screen. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Flat bone white #F6F1E7 background with an ultra-subtle paper grain. Top strip (y 0-4%): minimal status bar with the time on the left and generic signal, wifi and battery glyphs on the right in dark grey. Navigation bar (y 4-10%): a back chevron and the word 'Notas' in hot fuchsia #E6177F on the left, thin share and three-dot icons in fuchsia on the right. Note body in one left-aligned column at a 6% margin: a bold near-black title (y 12-17.5%), a small grey date line (y 18.5-21.5%), then a list of four single-line items (y 24-52%) each preceded by a round checkbox, the first one checked with a filled fuchsia check and the other three empty outlined circles; one translucent yellow #FFE45C hand-drawn highlighter stroke, slightly uneven, over the first item, text fully legible. Attached photo (x 6-94%, y 55-89%, rounded corners about 2.5% of the canvas): a casual top-down smartphone photo in soft window daylight of a striped coral-and-white beach towel with the real product in the center, label clearly visible, filling about 60-70% of the photo's height, next to a folded black one-piece swimsuit and a pair of tortoiseshell sunglasses. The product: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern, solid hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS'. Under the photo (y 91.5-95%), one small grey footnote line left-aligned at 6%. Flat UI, no shadows, no stickers, no emojis, no keyboard.

mandatory_visual_elements: Generic status bar and notes-app navigation bar with no real branding
Flat bone white note background with a screenshot look (no device frame)
Left-aligned four-item list with round checkboxes, the first one checked
One yellow hand-drawn highlighter stroke over the first item
Rounded-corner top-down photo of the real bottle on a beach towel with a swimsuit and sunglasses

final_generation_exclusions: No people, bodies or hands, in the UI or in the photo.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
